title: Rate Card Note — The Head-End Allowance in a Controls Upgrade Quotation
content:
# Rate Card Note — The Head-End Allowance in a Controls Upgrade Quotation

**The allowance.** Where the plan's covered panels stand at or above the tier's covered panel maximum under the Building Automation Service Plans and the twelve months to the handling day carry at least one support ticket closed on site, the head-end allowance is ten hours. Where the plan's covered panels stand at or above the tier's covered panel maximum and the twelve months to the handling day carry no support ticket closed on site, the head-end allowance is twelve hours. In every other case the head-end allowance is eight hours.

| Covered panels against the tier's covered panel maximum | Support tickets closed on site in the twelve months to the handling day | Head-end allowance |
|---|---|---|
| at or above it | at least 1 | 10 hours |
| at or above it | none | 12 hours |
| below it | any number | 8 hours |

## Points of judgement

- Covered panels standing exactly at the tier's covered panel maximum fall in the first two rows, the boundary being at or above it.
- The ticket count is of support tickets closed on site in the twelve months to the handling day; tickets closed remotely or with no fault found do not count towards it.

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

A plan covering 12 panels at a tier whose covered panel maximum is 12, with 2 support tickets closed on site in the twelve months, carries a head-end allowance of 10 hours. The same plan with no ticket closed on site carries 12 hours. A plan covering 9 panels at that tier carries 8 hours.
